name: squad
description: A live panel of this session's subagents as tiny vehicles: what each is doing, its model, effort, steps, context, tokens and time, with an activity bar and a one-line band above the prompt. /squad opens it.

autoOpen.title: Open the panel when a subagent starts
autoOpen.description: Opens it whenever an agent starts and it is not already open; /squad opens it by hand

askForSteps.title: Ask subagents to report their steps
askForSteps.description: Adds one line to each subagent's prompt asking it to call the squad step tool, so each row shows how far through its plan it is
